title: Fun to get, good value for the money
text: I got my first Allure Beauty Box, and I was really happy with it.  One of the products was full size (it was a Tarte mascara, which sells for $23.  That is more than the price of the box), and the others were generous.  They were good brands.  I have a few other beauty subscriptions, and this seems to be a pretty good one.  I am looking forward to future boxes.  I think it's well worth the price. I've heard several different places that the big benefit to getting this through Amazon is that if you do decide to cancel in the future, Amazon is much easier to deal with as far as cancellation goes.
label: positive
